overview.description: The North Square Disciplined Value ETF (NSIV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed narrow portfolio of US large-cap stocks considered to be exhibiting value characteristics. The fund uses their own bottom-up fundamental research in managing the portfolio. NSIV was launched on Jul 9, 2026 and is issued by North Square.

data.title: North Square Investments launches actively managed large cap equity ETFs
data.text: CHICAGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)---- $NSIG--North Square Investments today announced the launch of North Square Disciplined Value ETF (NSIV) and North Square Growth Opportunities ETF (NSIG).

news.t: North Square Investments launches actively managed large cap equity ETFs

holdings.infoBox: NSIV is an equity ETF with a total of 57 individual holdings. The top holdings are Amazon.com stock at 4.15%, Microsoft at 3.88%, Verizon Communications at 3.71%, U.S. Bancorp at 3.38%, and Alphabet at 3.03%.
